overview: The City Council approved Capital Stabilization Fund appropriations for traffic signal upgrades and an electric refuse truck, granted an extended-hours special permit for Panda Express, and passed resolutions supporting the Haitian community and exploring public restrooms.

items.title: Resolution Honoring Chevalier Theatre and Friends of Chevalier
items.summary: Approved a resolution recognizing the cultural importance of the Chevalier Theatre and commending the Friends of Chevalier and Gene Mack Gym.

items.title: Resolution in Support of Medford's Haitian and Immigrant Community
items.summary: Approved a resolution expressing unconditional support for Haitian residents and immigrants in Medford following national rhetoric and events in Springfield, Ohio.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Records
items.summary: Approved the records of the September 10, 2024 meeting.

items.title: Planning and Permitting Committee Report
items.summary: Approved the committee report on green score and incentive zoning discussions and referred the matter back for further review.

items.title: City Charter Review Referral
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the Governance Committee to establish a timeline and review upcoming recommendations from the Charter Study Committee.

items.title: Panda Express Special Permit for Extended Hours
items.summary: Approved an amended special permit allowing Panda Express to operate until midnight Monday through Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday through Sunday, conditioned on 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews and hosting a community day.

items.title: Sanitary Facilities in Public Spaces Resolution
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the Committee on Public Health and Community Safety to examine the feasibility and costs of installing public restrooms in city parks and commercial squares.

items.title: Capital Stabilization Fund Appropriations
items.summary: Approved two appropriations from the Capital Stabilization Fund totaling $461,535 for Spring Street traffic signal safety improvements and matching grant funds for an electric refuse truck.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Council President Bears read letters from two residents addressing council meeting decorum, community divisions, and support for the council.
